changes.title: Damaged statistics text
changes.text: Malformed encoded text is reported as damaged instead of being silently replaced with different identities or build information.

changes.title: Refresh derived statistics
changes.text: Existing rebuildable indexes and statistics caches refresh once so old replacement text cannot remain trusted.

changes.title: Raw-text integrity
changes.text: Added malformed and valid Unicode checks, including byte-for-byte preservation of a repaired tail backup.

changes.title: Healing screenshots
changes.text: Android verification now archives both the healing confirmation and threshold-setting screenshots.

changes.title: Verification records
changes.text: Recorded TEST99's passing tests and its missing archived images, plus this batch's reproduced data-integrity failures.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I tightened damaged-text handling so statistics do not invent identities from corrupted recordings. Existing caches rebuild from the original logs, and the Android checks now retain the new healing screenshots.
